title: The Roof Door
summary: On Day nine, the climb to the roof begins in the rain.

beats.text: Day nine. "Sam, it is a girl," whispered Mrs. Okafor. "She says she is Leo's sister."
Leo went white. "Dara knocks three slow times. Mum taught her, so they cannot copy it."

beats.speaker: okafor
beats.text: "She is not bitten. I checked," said Mrs. Okafor. "She comes with us."
We climbed in the dark, rain loud on the glass. Five. Six. Seven.
On seven, Mrs. Okafor opened her door. Dara stood behind her, soaked and shaking.
Leo just hugged her, and Biscuit wagged without a sound.
On twelve, my key slid into the roof lock, and it was already open.
The roof was empty, only a red flare burning. Dawn glowed on the harbour.
A man's voice behind us said, "You are late. The last boat left an hour ago."
